**PotentialHeat 1.3.0**

- **LEVEL MATCH now measures.** It compares how loud the sound is going in and coming out (over about a second) and turns the processed sound down by the difference, so louder never just sounds better. Before, it guessed from DRIVE alone. Projects with LEVEL MATCH on will now sit at the same loudness as the dry sound.
- **Drum-bus pair presets**: Boom Bap Bus, Lo-Fi Bus, Modern Bus and Glue Bus. They're in PotentialPunch 1.3.0 too, made to work together: put Punch first and Heat after it on your drum bus and pick the same name in each.
- The preset keys are a little narrower to fit the four new ones.

**Downloads**
- **`PotentialHeat-1.3.0-akai-vst2.zip`**: for **MPC OS 3.10.1 or later**, any standalone MPC (32-bit and 64-bit). Turn on **External Plugin Support** in Preferences → Enhancements (Beta), unzip, and copy the folder into **VST2 Plugins** at the top of a drive. See the [install guide](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialheat/blob/main/INSTALL-GUIDE.md).
- **`PotentialHeat-1.3.0-mpc-sdk.zip`**: the same plugin folder in the Open MPC catalog's 3.10.1 format (one folder for every MPC).
- **`PotentialHeat-1.3.0-mpc-armv7.zip`**: for Gen1 MPCs with the community plugin set-up on older MPC OS 3.x. Install it with the [Open MPC](https://open-mpc.github.io/) installer app, or follow `INSTALL.md` inside the zip. Save your project first, because installing restarts the MPC.
- **`PotentialHeat-1.3.0-mpc-aarch64.zip`**: the same for Gen2 MPCs (MPC Live III, XL), installed by the Open MPC Plugin Manager.

Install it one way only. Ideas, bugs and criticism are all welcome: [open an issue](https://github.com/PotentialBreakfast/mpc-vst-potentialheat/issues/new/choose).
